name: Queensland apprentice travel and accommodation allowance
summary: Queensland pays apprentices and trainees towards travel and accommodation when their closest training organisation is far away.
key: Up to 34c/km for road and rail travel, $58 per night intrastate and $112 per night interstate accommodation.
who: Registered apprentice or trainee in Queensland, part-time or full-time but not school-based
Travel more than 100 km return to your closest training organisation
how: Claim online through TRACC, or send the ATF-022 claim form (ATF-004 for flights).

source.label: Queensland Government: Travel and accommodation allowance

evidence.quote: up to 34c/km for road and rail travel
travel more than 100km return to your closest training organisation
claim your allowances within 6 months of travel
